newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends slightly up in lacklustre trade. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends slightly up in lacklustre trade. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Friday closed slightly up in lacklustre trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 596.58 from 595.76 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 1.23 million dinars against 312,163 dinars.
(Corrects trade volume figures which had been inverted)
Trade on the first market was low to 178,828 dinars while the bond market was active with the exchange of paper worth 743,365 dinars.
Chemical firm Alkimia was down 1.31 dinar to 42.29 dinars. BDET bank eased 0.52 dinar to 16.81 dinars.
